title: BREAKS 2.1: internal engine:assets heal leaks into Cue Transfers as a stuck 'Download 100%' row after a Pod session
description: Fabio live 2026-10-12 ~09:10Z, local after deleting the Pod: Cue > Transfers shows 'engine:assets  DOWNLOAD 100%' with Cancel, forever. engine:assets is the silent engine-asset heal (MPI-576) and must never show. Transfers (MPI-1057) is unreleased, so 2.1 would ship it to users. app.log (%APPDATA%/Cubric Studio/logs): 08:59:39 connect edge starts engine:assets ('fetching nothing; 5 on the volume or in flight'); 08:59:43 renderer reloaded (all SSE dropped, userFlows re-registered 08:59:45); 08:59:49 the new renderer starts engine:assets AGAIN; 09:05:56 Pod deleted. Two suspected faults, root cause NOT yet proven: (1) silence is renderer memory only (downloadService _silentJobs, set in _start, cleared on complete/failed), so a reload or a snapshot-restored job loses it while the job lives on (state.downloadJobs is persisted + server snapshot); fix belongs on the JOB (server stamps silent on the model job so snapshots carry it), not an id allowlist (MPI-576 removed that on purpose). (2) routes/downloadManager.js remote install with toInstall empty but deps 'in flight' elsewhere registers a model job in 'downloading' that completes only when those deps do; a Pod stop/delete mid-flight may leave it 'downloading' forever (check _checkModelJobsComplete + the remote-abandon path on delete). Reproduce: connect Pod, reload the renderer during the connect heal, delete the Pod. Verify: no engine:* row in Transfers at any point; no download job outlives its Pod. Cancel on the stuck row is safe in the meantime.
